title: Vacuum Refinery
description: The &3Vacuum Refinery&r is an oil refinery which processes &bPressurized/Desulfurized Crude Oil&r into 4 liquid products. It is a good way to make &bHigh-Performance Solvent&r by using &bReformate Gas&r and &bChlorine Gas&r in an &3Industrial Mixer&r.
&2Compressors are needed for the oil to be inserted inside the Vacuum Refinery.
